summary: The diff implements most of the requested requirements: frontend passcode gate, signal generator wizard, signal output card, market pulse voting, contact info section, poll creation, and visual theme. However, REQ-4 (backend Motoko generateSignal function with server-side indicator calculations) is critically violated — all indicator math is performed client-side in a frontend hook (useGenerateSignal.ts), not in a Motoko backend function. The backend main.mo does not contain a generateSignal function. Additionally, the unlock state uses backend access-grant rather than sessionStorage as specified.

missing_requirements.requirement: Create a Motoko backend function generateSignal(symbol: Text, timeframe: Text) : async SignalResult that fetches real OHLCV candle data from public APIs and computes all indicators (RSI, MACD, EMA, SMA, Bollinger Bands, ATR, Volume, ADX-style trend strength, Support & Resistance, Momentum) server-side in Motoko, with a weighted scoring system. API keys stored in stable backend state.
missing_requirements.reason: All indicator calculations are performed client-side in frontend/src/hooks/useGenerateSignal.ts (calcRSI, calcMACD, calcEMA, calcBollingerBands, calcATR, etc.). No generateSignal function is present in backend/main.mo. The hard constraint states all backend indicator calculations must be performed in Motoko, not in the frontend. API key storage and real OHLCV fetching via the backend are also absent.

missing_requirements.requirement: Unlock state must be stored in component state / sessionStorage so it survives re-renders but not a full new session.
missing_requirements.reason: MarketIntelPage.tsx uses useHasMarketIntelAccess and useGrantMarketIntelAccess which persist access to backend stable state across sessions, rather than using sessionStorage for session-scoped unlocking as specified.

hallucinated_features.description: Client-side OHLCV fetching and all technical indicator calculations (RSI, MACD, EMA, SMA, Bollinger Bands, ATR, Support & Resistance, Momentum, Trend Strength) implemented entirely in the frontend hook useGenerateSignal.ts, including a weighted scoring system.
hallucinated_features.reason: The build request explicitly states as a hard constraint that all backend indicator calculations must be performed in Motoko, not in the frontend. The diff moves all this logic to the frontend instead of the Motoko backend.

hallucinated_features.description: A backend migration module (migration.mo) defining an OldActor and NewActor schema migration for per-principal vote tracking.
hallucinated_features.reason: No migration module was requested in the build spec. While the Market Pulse feature was requested, a full migration.mo file with OldActor schema definition was not specified.
